finding: The npm audit triage step was visible in logs only, which made vulnerability review harder for GitHub Actions reviewers.
changes: Updated .github/workflows/security-ci.yml to write the non-blocking npm audit summary to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY.
Updated docs/ops/2026-06-13-npm-audit-triage.md to document where reviewers should inspect the generated summary.
next_steps: Inspect the next EuroComply Security CI job summary for concrete npm audit package names.
Apply targeted dependency updates only after the audit summary identifies the affected package chain.
Promote npm audit to a blocking gate only after production audit is clean or an explicit exception is accepted.
